description: Reduce Homebase special cases by converging managed apps toward standard health, readiness, metadata, manifest, and first-run onboarding contracts.

timing.plannedEarliestExecution: Parallelizable after core Homebase operations are stable
timing.gatingCondition: Requires app-by-app branches and acceptance tests in each managed repo.

principles: Homebase should manage contracts, not infer repo quirks forever
Fresh install should not depend on production seed.sql
Every app should tell Homebase whether it is alive, ready, and needs setup
Converge one app at a time
Keep demo data separate from required bootstrap data

techStack.language: Mostly Node/Express plus one Python/FastAPI app
techStack.runtime: Managed app endpoints + Homebase catalog/manifest metadata
techStack.storage: Each app's existing database plus Homebase catalog/manifest records
techStack.testing: Per-app endpoint tests and Homebase integration checks

userStories.title: Standard health/readiness/meta endpoints across apps
acceptanceCriteria: Each managed app exposes /api/health and /api/ready or manifest-declared equivalents
Each app exposes metadata: name, version/ref where practical, bootstrap capability
Homebase catalog records endpoint support accurately
userStories.testStrategy: Per-app endpoint tests plus Homebase probe tests

userStories.title: First-run onboarding replaces required seed data
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh migration-only install can start and serve setup/onboarding UI
App reports needs_household/needs_auth/ready state where applicable
Demo/dev seed data is optional and not required for production first use

userStories.title: App manifests become the Homebase abstraction boundary
acceptanceCriteria: Each repo carries or exports a managed-app manifest
Homebase can validate manifests and reduce hard-coded catalog drift
Backup paths, service names, health endpoints, onboarding endpoints, and timers are declared
userStories.testStrategy: Manifest schema tests and app-by-app Homebase install smoke tests

high: Cross-repo scope can sprawl and interrupt Homebase core hardening
medium: Changing first-run behavior can affect existing production deployments
low: Can proceed incrementally by app order

preFlightChecklist: Use the existing first-run onboarding suite plan as source context
Pick app order: Family Help, Family Dinner, Family Plan, Bitcoin Accounting, Family Pulse
Define manifest ownership and versioning approach
Define backward compatibility expectations for existing installs
